title: WPSS/2774/2018 of Mahesh Chandra AND ANOTHER Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
MCC. No. 1257 of 2018 (Recall Appl.)
In
WPSS No.2774 of 2018
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.
 Mr. Rajendra Arya, Advocate for
the petitioner.
 Mr. T.S. Bisht, Deputy Advocate
General for the State of Uttarakhand.
 Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
 Facts mentioned in the Recall
application are that the name and other
details of petitioner no. 1 have wrongly
been mentioned in the Writ Petition.
 The Recall application moved by
the petitioner no. 1 is allowed. Order
dated 14.08.2018 passed by this Court
so far same relates to petitioner no. 1 is
hereby recalled.
 Learned counsel for the petitioner
also prayed that petitioner no. 1 may be
permitted to withdraw the Writ Petition
with liberty to file fresh.
 Permission is granted.
 The Writ Petition is dismissed as
withdrawn, qua the petitioner no. 1 with
liberty to file fresh.
